about: samples.toml texts: each valid one with the samples it makes (SPEC §3.7), each refused one with the rule it breaks; see README.md

cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
[defaults]
[eras]
[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = "x.root"
tree = "T"

cases.rule: places, defaults, an era, trees and every form of files
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
p = "/data/"
[defaults]
tree = "T"
[eras]
[eras.E]
n = 7
[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = ["{p}/{n}.root", "~/b.root", "c/d.root", "root://h.org//e.root", "davs://h.org:443/f.root", "https://h.org/g.root"]
eras = ["E"]
trees = { p1 = "T1" }

cases.rule: eras and mass points named and labelled
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
lpc = "root://cmseos.fnal.gov//store/x/"
[defaults]
metadata = { lumi = 59.8 }
[eras]
[eras.UL17]
era = 2
[eras.UL18]
era = 3
[[sample]]
name = "Signal"
files = "{lpc}/{era}/s_{era}.root"
eras = ["UL17", "UL18"]
trees = { "300/292.5" = "SMS_300", "400/300" = "SMS_400" }
metadata = { kind = "signal", xsec = 2 }

cases.rule: metadata nested 59 deep, as deep as a header holds it
a number of events and a seed at TOML's largest, 2^63 − 1
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
[defaults]
[eras]
[[sample]]
name = "a"
tree = "T"
files = "x.root"
events = 9223372036854775807
choose = "random"
seed = 9223372036854775807

cases.rule: choices: first N, random with a seed, a default seed
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]

[defaults]
tree = "T"
events = 10
choose = "random"
seed = 7
[eras]

[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = "x.root"
[[sample]]
name = "b"
files = "y.root"
choose = "first"
[[sample]]
name = "c"
files = "z.root"
events = "all"
choose = "first"

cases.rust_says:
samples.toml is not TOML: TOML parse error at line 10, column 8
   |
10 | name = 
   |        ^
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
[defaults]
[eras]
[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = "x.root"
tree = "T"
name =

cases.rust_says: samples.toml has no key "sampel"; it takes format, version, places, defaults, eras, sample. Did you mean: sample?
cases.text:
sampel = 1
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
[defaults]
[eras]
[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = "x.root"
tree = "T"

cases.rust_says: samples.toml describes no sample: add one, [[sample]] with name = "…", files = "…" and tree = "…"
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
[defaults]
[eras]

cases.rust_says: [places] era: {era} is rvr's (an era's name, a sample's one file): give the place another name
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
era = "/d"
[defaults]

[eras]

[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = "x.root"
tree = "T"

cases.rust_says: [places] "a-b": a place's name is one or more ASCII letters, digits and _, as {NAME} uses it
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
"a-b" = "/d"
[defaults]

[eras]

[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = "x.root"
tree = "T"

cases.rust_says: [places] p must be text: a folder, a path or a URL
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
p = 3
[defaults]

[eras]

[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = "x.root"
tree = "T"

cases.rust_says: [defaults] cannot hold name, which belongs to one sample: give it in each [[sample]]
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]

[defaults]
name = "a"
[eras]

[[sample]]
name = "a"

tree = "T"

[defaults]

[eras]

cases.rust_says: the era "UL 18" must be a name (ASCII letters, digits, _ and -), since it becomes part of sample names: try "UL_18"
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]

[defaults]

[eras]
[eras."UL 18"]
era = 3
[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = "x.root"
tree = "T"

cases.rust_says: [eras.UL18] when: a date or time is not metadata: write it as text, in quotes
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]

[defaults]

[eras]
[eras.UL18]
when = 2026-11-02
[[sample]]
name = "a"
files = "x.root"
tree = "T"

cases.rust_says: sample "a b": a name holds only ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, since tools use it in commands and file names: use name = "a_b", and put the text in label
cases.text:
format = "rvr-samples"
version = 1
[places]
[defaults]
[eras]
[[sample]]
tree = "T"
files = "x"
name = "a b"

tree = "T"
